subject.title: fix(ssh-verify): preserve active cooldown entries during prune

question: When the cooldown cache is full and every existing entry is still active, should a new failed SSH probe receive no cached cooldown to preserve the hard cap, or should the cache be allowed to exceed MAX_COOLDOWN_ENTRIES?
rationale: The proposed break preserves existing cooldowns but removes the only demonstrated size-enforcement behavior; choosing the intended admission policy changes retry suppression and resource bounds under load.

options.title: Preserve the hard cap
options.body: Keep active entries and decline to add a new cooldown when no expired entry is available, with tests for the full-active-cache case.

options.title: Permit controlled overflow
options.body: Allow bounded overflow only if maintainers explicitly define a safe upper bound, lifecycle, and validation for trimming it later.

recommendation.title: Preserve the hard cap
recommendation.body: Keep active entries and decline to add a new cooldown when no expired entry is available, with tests for the full-active-cache case.
